The '''Eellayin''' were an ancient [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] before it was destroyed in a mysterious cataclysm, leaving an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] behind and the Ellayin all but extinct.

==History==
The few details about the Eellayin or the disaster that destroyed their homeworld caused them to vanish from most known history.<ref name="db">{{DB|species|polismassan|Polis Massan}}</ref>

Circa [[519 BBY/Legends|519 BBY]], long after their homeworld was destroyed, another species from the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]] investigated the remains of Polis Massa. These people, the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]], became so strongly associated with the archaeological investigation of Polis Massa that they became known as Polis Massans. The Polis Massans' main concern was uncovering what connection they may have had with the ancient Eellayin.<ref name="db" />
